items.label: Adjustable Straps for Customized Support and Comfort
items.value: This sports bra pack for women features adjustable straps that allow you to customize the fit for optimal support and comfort. Whether you're running, hiking, practicing yoga, or engaging in daily activities, the adjustable straps provide a tailored fit to relieve shoulder pressure, reduce discomfort, and ensure a secure, supportive experience during any workout.

items.label: Padded Design with Removable Padding for Versatility
items.value: The sports bra tops set includes a removable padding design, making it suitable for various activities. From high - intensity workouts like running and gym sessions to low - impact activities such as yoga, this bra offers the flexibility to meet your needs. The removable pads also allow you to adjust the level of support and comfort, making it versatile enough for both sports and everyday casual wear.

items.label: Innovative Double Criss - Cross Back Design for Style and Function
items.value: The innovative double criss - cross back design not only adds a stylish touch but also reduces shoulder strap slippage, ensuring a secure and comfortable fit. This design allows you to wear the sports bralette top on its own or pair it with other athletic wear. It’s the perfect combination of fashion and functionality, whether you're at the gym, dancing, or out on the street.

items.label: High Stretch Full Coverage Design for All Body Types
items.value: This sports bra activewear features a high - stretch, full - coverage design that supports a variety of body types, including different cup and chest sizes, plus - size or small sizes. Whether you have a larger or smaller bust, this wire - free bra provides optimal support and helps reduce breast movement during exercise, minimizing the risk of discomfort and potential tissue damage. It offers compression protection throughout any workout.

items.label: Breathable and Comfortable Fabric for All - Day Wear
items.value: Made with breathable, moisture - wicking fabric, this seamless cross - back sports bra keeps you cool and dry even during intense workouts. The fabric allows for excellent airflow, ensuring you stay comfortable and energetic no matter how long your session lasts. With its flexibility, it allows for natural movement, making it ideal for any activity from stretching to workouts, without any discomfort or restriction.

items.label: Fur Description
items.value: FITTIN sports bra offers adjustable straps for a perfect fit, padded Crossback design for breathability and chafe-free comfort, and removable pads for customized support. Its moisture-wicking fabric keeps you dry, while the ultra-elastic material adapts to any body type. Versatile for all activities, from sports to daily wear, this bra ensures comfort and support wherever you go.
